description: Get the account this connection is acting as: id, email, name, timezone and where notifications reach them. Use `timezone` when creating a scheduled workflow rather than defaulting to UTC, and `id` to tell your own runs and feedback from a teammate's in lists that carry only user ids.
name: get_me

notification_channel.description: Where notifications reach this person, e.g. "email", "push" or "none".

timezone.description: IANA timezone preference, or null if the account has never chosen one.

title: Get current user
